data.description:
S6.T4 wired worktree-removal-guards into harvest-worktree.sh with TWO guard call sites:
1. Pre-merge (lines 243-278): calls guard_protected_branch + guard_open_pr individually
2. Cleanup (line 411): assert_worktree_removable --force

The pre-merge guard_open_pr fails CLOSED when gh is unavailable or no remote configured — which is the case in test-harvest-worktree.sh fixture (mktemp+isolated git repo with no origin remote). Result: harvest exits 1 BEFORE merge happens, regressing 2 tests:
- test_cleanup_removes_worktree_after_successful_merge (5 assertions fail)
- test_cleanup_deletes_backing_branch_after_successful_merge (3 assertions fail)

Fix: REMOVE the pre-merge guard block (lines 243-278). Keep only the cleanup-time assert_worktree_removable --force check at line 411. Rationale: the pre-merge guards were over-aggressive for harvest context (content is being merged, not discarded — even if open PR exists, removing the source worktree post-merge is correct). The cleanup-time --force check still enforces guard_protected_branch (structural invariant).
data.title: harvest-worktree.sh S6.T4 pre-merge guards regress 2 test-harvest-worktree tests on CI
